claim_scope: RSC Advances 2015 review (Song, Park & Choi) states that bulk MoS2 is a layered material in which each layer is composed of three-atom-thick S-Mo-S stacks. Secondary-scholarly corroboration of the LAYERED nature of bulk MoS2.

locator.verbatim: MoS2, like graphite, is a layered material, where each layer of MoS2 is composed of three-atom-thick S-Mo-S stacks.

governance_note: ADMITTED (secondary_scholarly) via QUAL-RSC-MOS2-REVIEW-001 for 'layered_structure_mos2'. Corroborates the 'layered' component of Claim B; cannot alone establish a concept-level claim. originating_work WORK-SONG-PARK-CHOI-2015. Contract-C=(not_public,noindex).
